limitations: Automated source review is not qualified human scientific review or experimental reproduction.
No new model execution. Both results are author-reported, transcribed from the source without re-estimation.
Single post-cutoff temporal cohort (2026-03-03 to 2026-06-09), scored under two retriever configurations; not two independent cohorts and not an independent replication.

Partial, enriched-cohort coverage: 40 of 150 candidate CIViC entries are scored after sequential source-defined exclusions (68 full-text inaccessible, 14 already in train/dev/test, 2 data errors, 24 requiring supplementary/image evidence, 2 substantially revised claims); the source's own Discussion states this cohort is not representative of CIViC overall.
Pan-cancer; no EGFR- or NSCLC-specific subgroup, score, or clinical efficacy result is present anywhere in this addition.

This is within-linked-publication passage retrieval (the source paper for each claim is already known via CIViC's existing link), not an open-corpus literature-search or citation-context benchmark, and does not establish performance for finding appropriate studies across a clinical corpus.
Uncertainty is unreported in the source for this endpoint; no confidence interval is recomputed here.

v2's static SUPPORTS/REFUTES/NEI stance-classification accuracy (89% gold-evidence / 85% retrieved-evidence) and the v2-era BGE retriever manual-review figure (70/75) are distinct, version-specific measurements under a different task schema and are not ingested by this ingestion.

Table 2's evidence-retrieval entry/document counts (907/99/88 CIViC entries) and the Methods-stated retrieval-subset example counts (n_train=3456/n_dev=1194/n_test=1120) are different units from the same source; this ingestion does not resolve that apparent discrepancy by inference and does not ingest either figure.
This mapping does not close the benchmark-execution gap tracked separately at rewire-benchmarks #28.
The existing active mapping for this use case (use-case-mapping-20260930-345-ba1ec69965eb) and all CIViC MCP catalogue records remain byte-identical; this pass adds a second active mapping only.

Reviewer count, blinding and replicate/seed structure for the manual retrieval-success judgment (37/40 appropriate-content rate) are unreported in the source and are not assumed; the source's separately described curator/group-consensus process (Methods, 'Temporal evaluation') governs cohort reference-label assignment, not this retrieval judgment.

Model identifiers (ncbi/MedCPT-Cross-Encoder; Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-8B) are Huggingface namespace identifiers confirmed via Table 4, not pinned immutable checkpoint revisions; none is reported by the source and none is assumed.
